text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that sure was a fierce guardian deity.
*sigh* I'm pooped.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えらく凶暴な守り神だったわね。
あぁ、
疲れた～

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Aww, it fell apart after we defeated it.
I was going to place it near the entrance of our guild house 
as a decoration since it looked so cool. Oh well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらら、
倒したら壊れちゃいましたね。
カッコよかったからギルドハウスの玄関に飾ろうと思ったのに……
残念です。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pecorine.
If we were to place such an imposing statue in the guild house,
it would be fair to say that people would stop visiting the Gourmet Guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌさま。
さすがに
あのような物々しい像を飾っておいたら、
誰も【美食殿】を訪ねてこなくなってしまうのではないでしょうか。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: We'd totally be mistaken for some evil organization...
text_block_list.orig_text: どこからどう見ても悪の結社よね……
